scope: Additive text-v1 replica SDK and optional loopback operator gateway. No live public Sites storage migration.
review: A separate agent reviewed replica SDK authentication, conflict handling, preflight, all-copy independent verification, cancellation, diagnostics and PRF lifetime. Root reviewed gateway routing, size/origin/header bounds and test coverage. No blocker found in this scope. This is not an independent security audit.
limits: 2-3 intended stores; caller must configure distinct actual storage
No distributed atomic write; partial and unknown writes require read-only reconciliation
Different authenticated ciphertext is a conflict, not a latest-version vote
The optional gateway and two store processes share a machine/operator in the proof
Bundled two-app UI and public Sites still use single-store APIs
No production resilience, native prompt count, audit or external adoption claimed
